column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a soul without knowledge is not good” is rendered “it is not good for a soul to be without knowledge,” and “missing” “sins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “entreat the face” is rendered “entreat the favor.”
The last line is difficult; NKJV renders “He may pursue them with words, yet they abandon him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “acquires heart” is rendered “gets wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “destructions” is rendered “the ruin.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his deed” is rendered “what he has given.”
Close to the Hebrew; “do not lift your soul to putting him to death” is rendered “do not set your heart on his destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; טָמַן (“buries”) is rendered “buries,” and “dish” “bowl.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV renders the command “cease… to stray” as a consequence, “And you will stray.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a witness of Belial” is rendered “A disreputable witness.”
